name: ui-3d-reveal
title: 3D UI Reveal
description: A logo mark draws on, then a design-tool window (layers, canvas, properties) flies in flat, pushes in, tilts into 3D and flies away, ending on a logo, tagline and link pill.
useWhen: A product or app needs a cinematic 'here is the interface' moment: reveal, push in, tilt, leave.
A short brand open and close (logo draws on, tagline, link) around a UI showcase.
avoidWhen: The real interface of your own product must be shown: use a screenshot or screen recording.
The video is short and light: this runs 13 seconds and keeps a 3D layer busy.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
